plugin.name: Climatology
plugin.summary: Global monthly climate and cyclone data with source provenance
plugin.author: Sean D'Epagnier; modernisation contributors
plugin.description: Monthly ERA5 winds and atmosphere, OSCAR currents, OISST sea temperature, IBTrACS cyclones and GEBCO bathymetric context. Includes the complete ocpn-climatology-2026.2 dataset, source periods, checksums and validation. Historical LIS/OTD lightning is retained with its provenance limitation. Research and passage planning climatology; not a forecast or official navigation data.
